sentences.text: The Motor Accident Claims Tribunal (MACT), Srinagar passed an award dated 18.06.2015 in a claim petition on file No. 250/2011 instituted on 10.07.2011 by five claimants, who are respondents 1 to 5 herein.

2. The MACT, Srinagar vide award dated 18.06.2015 granted compensation of an amount of Rs.
19,69,200/- (Rupees Nineteen lacs Sixty Nine thousand and Two hundred) along with interest @
6% p.a from the date of presentation of the claim petition till actual realization.

3. The liability to pay the compensation so awarded was rested upon the insurer of the offending vehicle which is the National Insurance Company Ltd.
4.
An appeal under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 was filed by the said Insurance Company on 17.10.2015 assailing the award both on quantum as well as on the liability aspect.
5. During the pendency of the appeal, the matter was referred to Lok Adalat for an amicable settlement.

In terms of Lok Adalat award passed by Bench No. 2 on 11.12.2021 compensation was reduced from Rs. 19,69,200/- to Rs.18,57,900/- with interest @ 6% p.a to be paid with effect from National Insurance Co vs Saif Ud Din Kalas And Ors on 5 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/181417543/
1 the date of award.

sentences.text:
6. Aggrieved of this reference of computation of interest on the settled award amount of Rs.
18,57,900/-, the claimants/respondents 1 to 5 came forward with an application bearing CM No.
198/2022 for correcting the reference of payment of interest as paid by the Lok Adalat award wherein the interest was reckoned payable from date of award rather than from the date of filing of the claim petition as originally granted in the award dated 18.06.2015.
7.
The application filed by the claimants/respondents 1 to 5 is factually and legally correct.

The interest payable on the compensation could not have been from the date of Lok Adalat award but from the date of filing of the claim petition and, as such, to that extent the Lok Adalat award dated 11.12.2021 shall be read bearing a reference of payment of interest @ 6% p.a from the date of filing of the claim petition till actual realization.

The appellant-National Insurance Co. Ltd. is directed to recalculate the interest component payable with respect to compensation of amount of Rs.
18,57,900/- from the date of institution of claim petition till its actual payment and accordingly the appellant-National Insurance Co. Ltd would update the total amount payable in favour of the claimants/respondents 1 to 5 and outstanding interest component be also deposited with the Registrar Judicial, Srinagar within a period of two months.
9. Disposed of.
10. Parties shall be at liberty to lay a motion in case there is any dispute or difference with respect to the computation of the interest made in the matter.

( RAHUL BHARTI) JUDGE SRINAGAR 05.10.2024 Sakeena National Insurance Co vs Saif Ud Din Kalas And Ors on 5 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/181417543/
